local_review.finding_body: The original Jte_runtimeTest.java covered dynamic access in both gg.jte.runtime.RuntimeTemplateLoader and gg.jte.runtime.Template. The test contract requires each dynamic-access class to have its own dedicated test file.
local_review.finding_title: Dynamic-access classes shared a generic test file
local_review.fix_note: Split the existing assertions into RuntimeTemplateLoaderTest.java and TemplateTest.java, retaining Jte_runtimeTest.java only as their shared precompiled-engine helper. This preserves the original public-API behavior and coverage while establishing the required one-to-one test-file mapping.
local_review.review_comment: Verified the contribution is scoped to gg.jte:jte-runtime:3.2.4, uses only reachability-metadata.json, has non-scaffold public-API tests in a separate version-agnostic package, and adds no native skip, compatibility override, or native build/run flag. The resolved statistics report 11/11 dynamic-access calls covered (100%) and 13 reported metadata entries, so the coverage gate passes and the entry-count mismatch probe is not triggered. Index validation evidence is green, and the finalization command passed all three test lanes plus metadata, style, generated-test, and statistics checks without further publishable changes.
